h1: Varunyu House & Resort — a roadside budget stay with roomy units and easy parking in Maha Sarakham
intro: Want a low-cost place in Maha Sarakham that is easy to find, right on a main road, and stress-free to park at? Varunyu House & Resort (Waranyoo House & Resort) is a small single-storey resort in the Talat area, fronting Chaloem Phra Kiat Rama 9 Road · What reviewers mention most is roomy units, cold AC, clean rooms and friendly prices, each with a fridge, TV and free parking right outside the door · It sits close to Kaeng Loeng Chan park and the city museum · Prices start from approx. ฿450/night and it holds a score of 8.3 from 23 reviews on Traveloka — solid for this price bracket.
galleryAlts: The single-storey resort building of Varunyu House & Resort, Maha Sarakham, with parking outside the rooms

body.html: Varunyu House & Resort, known in Thai as Waranyoo House & Resort, sits at 163 Chaloem Phra Kiat Rama 9 Road, Talat sub-district, Mueang Maha Sarakham — what guests like most is the main-road location with clear signage that is easy to spot, simple to get in and out of and easy to park at · It is a small single-storey resort of about 28 rooms in a long row, where you park right outside your door, which makes it handy for self-drivers: people running errands in town, relatives staying near a patient at the hospital, and parents bringing students for exams or enrolment at Mahasarakham University.

Rooms are air-conditioned — many reviews call them roomier than expected, with cold AC, and clean · Each has a refrigerator, cable TV, a kettle in some rooms, and a private bathroom with shower · There is Wi-Fi in the common areas, free parking outside the room, and a front desk · There is no breakfast and no pool, as this is a budget stay built around clean bedrooms and an easy-to-find location, with restaurants and convenience stores within walking distance nearby.
"Clean rooms, nice and spacious, cold AC, reasonable price, right on the main road with clear signage so it is easy to find, parking available, friendly staff — good value for the price."

What earns Varunyu House & Resort its 8.3 is location and value · On Traveloka's sub-scores, location reaches 8.7, service 8.4, cleanliness 8.0 and room comfort 8.2 · Most reviews praise the clean rooms, cold AC, easy access, and proximity to restaurants and the hospital, plus Kaeng Loeng Chan park and the Maha Sarakham City Museum, both less than a kilometre or two away · Many call it a sensible choice for an overnight stay while running errands: a clean room at a low price.

To be honest — this is a budget 2-star stay, not a full-service hotel · Some reviews note the rooms and furniture are starting to show their age, even though they are clean · Because it is a single-storey resort on a main road, light sleepers may hear some traffic at times · The food sub-score sits at 7.5, which reflects that dining is not a strength here, and there is no in-house breakfast, so it is worth planning to find food nearby.

In short, Varunyu House & Resort suits anyone who wants a low-cost place in Maha Sarakham with roomy units, cold AC, clean rooms, an easy-to-find location and simple parking · Set your expectations right — a budget stay built around the bedroom and location rather than a luxury resort — and it does the job well · Its score of 8.3 from 23 reviews reflects that most guests leave satisfied, especially self-drivers who want an easy-to-find place at a budget price.

honestSummary: Varunyu House & Resort is a budget stay with roomy units, cold AC, clean rooms, an easy-to-find location and simple parking, ideal for anyone who wants a low-cost base in Maha Sarakham near Kaeng Loeng Chan and the city centre · The trade-off is dated rooms, no breakfast and some traffic noise from the main road.
honestChecks: If you are a light sleeper sensitive to noise — this is a single-storey resort on a main road and you may hear some traffic → ask for an interior room away from the road and pack earplugs.

If you want a pool, breakfast or full hotel services — this is a budget stay focused on clean rooms and location → consider a higher-tier property in the province such as Taksila or DEBUA White House.

If you expect brand-new rooms and furniture — reviews note the rooms are starting to age even though they are clean → check recent photos and reviews before booking, or pick a recently renovated place.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Varunyu House & Resort, Maha Sarakham

faq.q: Where is Varunyu House & Resort in Maha Sarakham?
faq.a: It sits at 163 Chaloem Phra Kiat Rama 9 Road, Talat, Mueang Maha Sarakham · It is a roadside resort with clear signage that is easy to find, close to Kaeng Loeng Chan park (about 290 m), the city museum, restaurants and the hospital.

faq.q: What kind of property is Varunyu House & Resort?
faq.a: It is a budget 2-star stay, a single-storey resort of about 28 rooms · Rooms are air-conditioned with a fridge, cable TV and a private bathroom with shower, and there is free parking right outside the room.

faq.q: What are the starting prices and room types?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿450/night for a Standard room · There are also Standard King and larger family rooms · Prices vary by season, so compare Agoda and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does Varunyu House & Resort have breakfast and a pool?
faq.a: No — there is no breakfast and no pool, as this is a budget stay focused on clean bedrooms and an easy-to-find location · There is free parking outside the room and Wi-Fi in common areas, with restaurants and convenience stores within walking distance nearby.

faq.q: Is Varunyu House & Resort noisy — is it comfortable to sleep in?
faq.a: Rooms are roomy with cold AC and many guests sleep well, but as a single-storey resort on a main road, you may hear some traffic at times · If you are a light sleeper, ask for an interior room away from the road and pack earplugs.

faq.q: Who is Varunyu House & Resort best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone who wants a low-cost place with roomy units, cold AC, clean rooms, an easy-to-find location and simple parking · It is great for self-drivers, people running errands in town, relatives visiting a patient, and parents bringing students to Mahasarakham University, and less ideal for those wanting full hotel facilities.
